official: 品川区立学校の学校医、学校歯科医および学校薬剤師の公務災害補償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第2回定例会 提出議案

name: 学校医などの公務災害補償額を改定
summary: 現在、区立学校の学校医などへの公務災害補償の基礎額は、条例の別表で定めています。この議案で、4つの額を14,175円、14,175円、16,467円、17,496円から、それぞれ14,397円、15,198円、17,259円、17,937円に改めます。改定後の額は、2026年4月1日以降に支給する理由が生じた場合などに適用します。

en.name: Revises compensation amounts for work-related injuries of school doctors and others
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Compensation for Work-Related Injuries of School Doctors, School Dentists, and School Pharmacists at Shinagawa City Schools
en.summary: The compensation base amounts for work-related injuries of school doctors and others at city schools are currently set in a table attached to the ordinance. This bill changes four amounts from ¥14,175, ¥14,175, ¥16,467, and ¥17,496 to ¥14,397, ¥15,198, ¥17,259, and ¥17,937, respectively. The revised amounts apply when a reason for payment arises on or after April 1, 2026, among other cases.
changes: Raises the compensation base amount from ¥14,175 to ¥14,397
Raises the compensation base amount from ¥14,175 to ¥15,198
Raises the compensation base amount from ¥16,467 to ¥17,259
Raises the compensation base amount from ¥17,496 to ¥17,937
en.why: The ward says it is necessary to revise the compensation base amounts in light of an amendment to the ordinance for Tokyo Metropolitan Government schools.
